•  So far we've covered obstacle avoidance for mobile robots
   (a single body moving on the ground plane).

Attractive and Repulsive Fields
•  Attractive potential: strongest pull when far from the goal, decreasing
   as the end-effector gets closer (like a valley centered on the goal).

   effector, so the elbow and forearm can independently be pushed away
   from nearby obstacles while the hand still moves
   toward the goal.
